issues: Inbox 界面是灰色骨架条（黑色长条当姓名、紫色长条当摘要），显影后读不出是一个收件箱
相机漂移插值没有钳位，扩张结束后继续外推缩放，画面底边露出一条黑边
没有导出时长，工作台按默认 150f 渲染，全亮后空停 50f
开场 1.75 倍特写把 Inbox 的 I 和 All tab 裁掉半截；光前沿只是一圈灰色过渡，没有这张卡"紫光"的身份
changes: 界面换成可信的收件箱：Inbox 标题 + 12 new chip、分类 tab、4 条消息（复选框 / 未读点 / 首字母头像 / 发件人 + 动作 + 时间 / 摘要 / 类型 chip），系统字体与发丝分隔线
相机漂移改为 0–112f 缓出收住后静止并钳位，底边露黑消失；补导出 CORNER_SPOTLIGHT_REVEAL_DURATION = 130（100f 匀速扩张 + 30f 全亮停留）
光前沿羽化带挂一圈 screen 叠加的紫色辉边：黑场里是紫光、照亮处自然消失，全亮前淡出；聚光半径与光心仍严格 linear
内容左上留足边距，开场特写不再裁字；光心白热光晕降一档并偏暖；加轻暗角与颗粒防暗场色带
issuesEn: The Inbox UI was grey skeleton bars (black bars for names, purple bars for previews), so once lit it never read as an inbox
The camera drift interpolation was unclamped and kept extrapolating after the reveal, exposing a black strip along the bottom edge
No duration was exported, so the workbench used the default 150f and the fully lit frame sat idle for 50f
The 1.75× opening close-up cut the I of Inbox and the All tab in half; the light front was just a grey transition with none of this card's violet identity
changesEn: The UI is now a believable inbox: Inbox title with a 12 new chip, category tabs and four messages (checkbox, unread dot, initials avatar, sender + action + time, preview, type chip) in the system font with hairline dividers
Camera drift now eases out over 0–112f then holds, clamped, so the black edge is gone; exported CORNER_SPOTLIGHT_REVEAL_DURATION = 130 (100f linear expansion + 30f fully lit hold)

A screen-blended violet rim rides the middle of the light front's feather band: violet glow in the dark, vanishing where lit, fading before full reveal; spotlight radius and centre remain strictly linear
Content has enough top-left margin that the opening close-up no longer clips text; the hot spot is one notch dimmer and warmer; light vignette and grain prevent banding in the dark
